description: Public LinkedIn post URLs or IDs. Returns total reactions and exact reaction-type counts; no cookie or login is needed.

emitNoResultsMarker.description: When no public post can be resolved, add one marker row instead of failing with an empty dataset.
emitNoResultsMarker.title: Emit a No-Results Marker

postUrls.description: Public LinkedIn posts to summarize. Accepts /posts/ links (activity, share or ugcPost), /feed/update/urn:li:... links, embed links, bare numeric IDs, lnkd.in short links and country subdomains.
postUrls.title: LinkedIn Post URLs or IDs

reactionTypeFilter.description: Optional post filter. A post is returned only when at least one selected reaction type has a count above zero. Every returned row still contains all available counts.
reactionTypeFilter.title: Only Posts With These Reactions

title: LinkedIn Post Reaction Summary Input
